headline: Microsoft Plans $25 Billion Bond Sale to Fund Artificial Intelligence
summary: Microsoft is seeking to raise $25 billion through a US bond offering to finance investments in artificial intelligence infrastructure and expansion.
why: Microsoft is a leading global technology firm heavily investing in AI infrastructure. Mega-scale bond issuances test corporate debt market appetite and signal massive ongoing capital commitments to AI development.

impacts.name: US Corporate Debt
impacts.why: A massive $25 billion debt issuance adds significant supply to the primary corporate bond market.
